name: EdgeDirectHostRequestSurge
expr:
sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{host=~"_|.+\\.(k8s|apps\\.kubernetes|apps\\.k8s|web)\\.example.com|(auth-admin|auth-admin-api|clickhouse|elastic|ucs)\\.example.com"}[5m])) > 200
and on (host)
sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{host=~"_|.+\\.(k8s|apps\\.kubernetes|apps\\.k8s|web)\\.example.com|(auth-admin|auth-admin-api|clickhouse|elastic|ucs)\\.example.com"}[5m]))
  > 3 * (
    max by (host) (
      sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{host=~"_|.+\\.(k8s|apps\\.kubernetes|apps\\.k8s|web)\\.example.com|(auth-admin|auth-admin-api|clickhouse|elastic|ucs)\\.example.com"}[5m] offset 1w))
      or label_replace(sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{host=~"_|.+\\.(k8s|apps\\.kubernetes|apps\\.k8s|web)\\.example.com|(auth-admin|auth-admin-api|clickhouse|elastic|ucs)\\.example.com"}[5m] offset 2w)), "week", "2", "", "")
    )
    or 0 * sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{host=~"_|.+\\.(k8s|apps\\.kubernetes|apps\\.k8s|web)\\.example.com|(auth-admin|auth-admin-api|clickhouse|elastic|ucs)\\.example.com"}[5m]))
  )

name: EdgeHostFloodImpact
expr:
(
  sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests[5m])) > 150
  and on (host)
  sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests[5m]))
    > 2 * (
      max by (host) (
        sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests[5m] offset 1w))
        or label_replace(sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests[5m] offset 2w)), "week", "2", "", "")
      )
      or 0 * sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests[5m]))
    )
)
and on (host)
(
  (
    sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{status=~"5.."}[5m])) > 5
    and on (host)
    (
      sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{status=~"5.."}[5m]))
      / sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests[5m]))
    ) > 0.05
  )
  or on (host)
  (
    1 - sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="1"}[5m]))
      / sum by (host) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]))
  ) > 0.05
)

name: SeaweedFSVolumeSlotsLow
expr:
# 2026-11-12 outage: -max=0 auto-sized the server to 46 slots on
# a half-empty disk; once all were used the master had no
# writable volume for nodestore-fast and every Sentry event save
# failed (PutObject InternalError) for ~1 h. A full disk also
# blocks volume.tier.upload, so slot exhaustion does not
# self-heal. Each new TTL bucket/day needs a fresh volume.
max by (namespace, instance) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_max_volumes{job="seaweedfs-volume"})
- on (namespace, instance)
sum by (namespace, instance) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_volumes{job="seaweedfs-volume"})
< 5
